title: Universal delta-functor embedding for quasi-coherent modules
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme], and let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There is a monomorphism F \to F' of quasi-coherent O_X-modules such that H^p(X,F') = 0 for every p >= 1.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-affine-diagonal-universal-delta-functor, embedding into a sheaf acyclic for higher cohomology

proof.text: Apply the geometric affine-cover embedding lemma to F, obtaining an affine source U, affine j: U → X, quasi-coherent G and a monomorphism F → j_*G.
Take F′=j_*G. Affine pushforward preserves quasi-coherence.

For p≥1 write p=q+1. Affine-scheme vanishing makes Modules.H G (q+1) a subsingleton. The module/source cohomology additive equivalence transfers this to moduleCohomology on U. The affine-morphism edge map is an isomorphism from moduleCohomology on X of j_*G to that on U of G, so its injectivity transfers subsingletonness to the source. A subsingleton ModuleCat object is zero. The previously obtained monomorphism and quasi-coherence give the desired witness.
